ImageDescription.value:
Church of All Souls and BBC Broadcasting House, Langham Place.
View northward from Upper Regent Street. Badly damaged by a parachute mine in the Blitz (8 December 1940), the church lost the top of its spire and was out of use for 10 years. Broadcasting House, which had been hit already on 15 October, was also damaged.
